source: NASA closed captions, cut to the clip; NOT yet verified by hand
text_en: Well STS-1 was a pure test mission. All we really wanted to do was to prove the system would work. So our job was to take off, get into orbit, check out all the systems on the vehicle and bring it in safely for a landing.
